note: p = official forecast (AGG_RT): mean of three blind lenses after red-team adjustment. Probabilities 0.01-0.99.

forecasts.question: Will the president of Russia sign by 31.12.2026 a decree announcing mobilisation (general or partial)?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 a decree of the president of the Russian Federation announcing mobilisation (the term "mobilisation" in the title or operative part) under the law on mobilisation preparation and mobilisation is published on publication.pravo.gov.ru or kremlin.ru. Decrees on conscription (including no. 998 of 29.12.2025), on exercises and special reserve formations, or on contract service do not count.

forecasts.question: Will at least one person be killed on the territory of a NATO state by a Russian drone or missile strike by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the government of a NATO state confirms that after 23.09.2026 at least one person was killed on its territory (land, territorial waters, airspace) by a drone or missile launched by Russia, including one that strayed or was shot down over that territory. Attribution to Russia — in the government statement.

forecasts.question: Will the Pentagon or the White House announce by 31.03.2027 a decision to reduce the number of US troops in Europe by at least 10,000?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an official statement (defense.gov, whitehouse.gov, eucom.mil) published after 23.09.2026 announces a decision (not an option or a leak) to reduce US troop strength in Europe by at least 10,000 soldiers net, in total across one or more announcements after 23.09.2026. Moves within Europe do not reduce strength. Reductions announced before 23.09.2026 do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the net gain of Ukrainian territory occupied by Russia in October 2026 exceed 200 km² according to DeepState?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the DeepState monthly summary for X 2026 shows a net gain (occupied minus recaptured) above 200 km². If DeepState gives only a gross value — use it. Secondary sources citing DeepState (ISW, Russia Matters, news agencies) are acceptable.

forecasts.question: Will the PRC Eastern Theater Command announce named military exercises around Taiwan by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the PLA Eastern Theater Command or the PRC Ministry of National Defense announces exercises with a proper name covering the area around Taiwan. Unnamed combat-readiness patrols do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: eng.chinamil.com.cn; mod.gov.cn; Xinhua; Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense

forecasts.question: Will the settlement price of the ICE Brent front-month contract exceed 120 USD/bbl on any trading day between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if on any trading day in this period the settlement (closing) price of nearest-month ICE Brent > 120.00 USD/bbl. Sources: ICE or Reuters, CNBC, Trading Economics; in case of discrepancy ICE decides.

forecasts.question: Will the settlement price of the ICE Brent front-month contract fall below 80 USD/bbl on any trading day between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if on any trading day in this period the settlement (closing) price of nearest-month ICE Brent < 80.00 USD/bbl. Sources: ICE or Reuters, CNBC, Trading Economics; in case of discrepancy ICE decides.

forecasts.question: Will the settlement price of the TTF front-month contract exceed 90 EUR/MWh on any trading day between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if on any trading day in this period the settlement price of nearest-month ICE Endex TTF > 90.00 EUR/MWh. Sources: ICE Endex or Trading Economics, Reuters; in case of discrepancy ICE Endex decides.

forecasts.question: Will EU gas storage fill per GIE AGSI+ on gas day 01.01.2027 be below 55.0%?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the EU storage fill value (EU, % of capacity) in AGSI+ for gas day 01.01.2027 < 55.0. The first publication for that day counts.

forecasts.question: Will the US president impose a tariff under H.R. 5334 on goods from at least one country other than Russia by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 a proclamation, executive order or Federal Register notice is published imposing a tariff on goods from a country other than Russia with reference to H.R. 5334 (Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026), with an effective date no later than 31.12.2026. An announcement without an act does not count.

forecasts.question: Will the USA introduce a tariff on EU goods exceeding the 15% ceiling set in the 2026 agreement by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the US government publishes an act (proclamation, executive order, USTR notice in the Federal Register) raising the combined tariff rate above 15% on EU goods covered by the "all-inclusive" ceiling, with an effective date no later than 31.03.2027. Not counted: section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminium, categories excluded from the ceiling as of 23.09.2026, and anti-dumping and countervailing duties.

forecasts.question: Will the Monetary Policy Council change the NBP reference rate at any meeting between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the MPC statement after a meeting in this period changes the reference rate (in either direction).

forecasts.question: Will the ECB raise the deposit rate at a meeting held between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after a meeting of the ECB Governing Council in this period (29.10 or XII) the deposit rate is higher than 2.50%.

forecasts.question: Will OFAC add to the SDN list by 31.03.2027 a bank registered in mainland PRC in connection with Iran or Russia?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an OFAC notice (Recent Actions) after 23.09.2026 adds to the SDN list a bank (an institution with a banking licence) registered in the PRC outside Hong Kong and Macao, with a justification relating to Iran or Russia. Branches of foreign banks in the PRC and non-bank institutions do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the EU Council adopt the 22nd package of sanctions against Russia by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the EU Council announces the formal adoption of a package of sanctions against Russia named in the Council statement as the 22nd package.

forecasts.question: Will the Bank of Russia cut its key rate at the meeting scheduled for 23.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after the Bank of Russia board meeting on 23.10.2026 (or a rescheduled one, no later than 31.10.2026) the key rate is lower than 14.00%.

forecasts.question: Will the PRC announce by 10.11.2026 an extension or repeal of the suspension of the rare-earth export controls introduced on 09.10.2025?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 and no later than 10.11.2026 MOFCOM or GAC (or Xinhua quoting MOFCOM) announces an extension of the suspension of the controls of 09.10.2025 (MOFCOM announcements of 2025 nos. 55–58, 61, 62) for any period, or their permanent repeal. An extension of some of the announcements counts if it covers rare-earth controls.

forecasts.question: Will the PRC announce by 27.11.2026 an extension or repeal of the suspension of the ban on exports of gallium, germanium, antimony and superhard materials to the USA?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 and no later than 27.11.2026 MOFCOM announces an extension of the suspension of this ban for any period or its permanent repeal.

forecasts.question: Will MOFCOM add at least one US entity to the export control list or the unreliable entity list between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if a MOFCOM announcement published in this period contains a new listing of a US entity on the export control list (出口管制管控名单) or the unreliable entity list.

forecasts.question: Will the US government permit exports to the PRC of Nvidia AI chips with the Blackwell architecture or newer by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the Department of Commerce (BIS) or the White House announces permission (a rule, licences or a licensing policy) for exports to the PRC of at least one Nvidia chip with the Blackwell architecture or newer (including a reduced-performance version), or Nvidia officially confirms receiving such permission.

forecasts.question: Will PRC exports of rare-earth permanent magnets to the USA in September 2026 exceed 512 t?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the first publication of PRC General Administration of Customs data for IX 2026 shows exports of rare-earth permanent magnets to the USA above 512 t (the value for VIII). Secondary sources citing GAC (SMM, Reuters, Bloomberg) are acceptable.

forecasts.question: Will a trilateral meeting of government delegations of the USA, Ukraine and Russia take place by 30.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 at least two of the three parties (the Kremlin, the Office of the President of Ukraine, the White House or State Department) officially confirm a meeting of government delegations of all three states in one place, at any level.

forecasts.question: Will any NATO state submit a request for consultations under Article 4 of the North Atlantic Treaty between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if NATO or the government of a member state confirms that a request for consultations under Article 4 was submitted in this period.

forecasts.question: Will the USA and Iran announce by 31.12.2026 the conclusion of an agreement (framework, interim or final) that includes the opening of the Strait of Hormuz?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 official sources of both governments (White House or State Department, and the president or Foreign Ministry of Iran) confirm the conclusion of an agreement, including a memorandum or interim agreement, whose announced content includes opening or restoring shipping through Hormuz. Declarations of readiness and frameworks for further talks without an agreed text do not count.

forecasts.question: Will Donald Trump personally attend the APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen (18–19.11.2026)?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if Trump is physically present at the APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen, as confirmed by the White House or at least two news agencies. Remote participation or a delegation without the president — NO. If the leaders' meeting does not take place by 30.11.2026 — NO.

forecasts.question: Will Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump meet in person by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 Putin and Trump meet in person, as confirmed by the Kremlin and the White House.

forecasts.question: Will the Republican Party win at least 218 seats in the House of Representatives in the 03.11.2026 elections?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if according to AP race calls or results certified by the Clerk of the House Republicans win at least 218 seats. If by 31.12.2026 no party has 218 called seats — resolve on the day AP announces control of the House.

forecasts.question: Will a new video or audio recording of Mojtaba Khamenei speaking be published by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 official Iranian media (IRIB, khamenei.ir, leader.ir) publish a video or audio recording of him speaking or appearing in public, and at least two independent international media consider it new and authentic. Written statements, photos and archive recordings do not count.

forecasts.question: Will Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva win the 2026 presidential election in Brazil (first round 04.10 or second round 25.10)?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) declares Lula the winner of the 2026 presidential election in the first or second round.

forecasts.question: Will the CNE or the government of Venezuela announce a specific date for the presidential election by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the CNE or the government of Venezuela publishes a schedule with a specific voting day for the presidential election.

forecasts.question: Will Assimi Goïta cease to hold power in Mali by 31.03.2027 (coup, resignation, death or capture of Bamako by JNIM or the FLA)?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if at least two independent international media confirm that after 23.09.2026 Goïta ceased to serve as transitional president or lost de facto control over Bamako.
forecasts.resolution_source: news agencies (AFP, Reuters, AP); Al Jazeera; ACLED

forecasts.question: Will the 7-day average number of transits through the Strait of Hormuz per IMF PortWatch exceed 40 ships per day on any day between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if IMF PortWatch data (transit calls, Strait of Hormuz) show a 7-day average above 40 for any day in this period.

forecasts.question: Will IMF PortWatch record at least 20 transits through the Strait of Hormuz on any day between 24.09 and 07.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the daily number of transits (transit calls) in IMF PortWatch data for the Strait of Hormuz is at least 20 on any day in this period.

forecasts.question: Will the USA officially lift or suspend the naval blockade of Iranian ports by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the White House, the Pentagon or CENTCOM announces the lifting or suspension (including temporary) of the blockade of Iranian ports as a whole.

forecasts.question: Will the Panama Canal Authority raise the daily transit limit above 32 by 31.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an ACP statement (advisory to shipping) announces a limit higher than 32 transits per day, in force on any day by 31.10.2026.

forecasts.question: Will the government or prosecutor of a Baltic Sea state announce by 31.03.2027 damage to a subsea cable or pipeline in the Baltic together with proceedings concerning external action?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the government or prosecutor of PL, DE, DK, SE, FI, EE, LV or LT announces damage to a subsea cable (power or telecommunications) or pipeline in the Baltic Sea and the opening of an investigation or the detention of a ship on suspicion of external action (sabotage, dragged anchor). Technical failures without such proceedings do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: statements of governments and prosecutors of Baltic Sea states; Reuters

forecasts.question: Will EU gas storage fill per GIE AGSI+ on gas day 06.10.2026 exceed 73.0%?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the EU storage fill value in AGSI+ for gas day 06.10.2026 > 73.0. The first publication for that day counts.

forecasts.question: Will CENTCOM or the Pentagon announce a US strike on a target on Iranian land territory by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 an official statement by CENTCOM, the Pentagon or the White House confirms a US strike on a target on land in Iran. Strikes on vessels and in Yemen or Iraq do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: centcom.mil; defense.gov; Reuters/AP as second source

forecasts.question: Will the FOMC raise the target range for the federal funds rate at the 27–28.10.2026 meeting?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after the FOMC meeting on 27–28.10.2026 the upper bound of the target range is higher than 4.00%.

forecasts.question: Will EU gas storage fill per GIE AGSI+ on gas day 01.11.2026 be at least 80.0%?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the EU storage fill value in AGSI+ for gas day 01.11.2026 ≥ 80.0. The first publication for that day counts.

forecasts.question: Will US forces carry out a strike on Houthi targets in Yemen by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 CENTCOM, the Pentagon or the White House confirms a US strike on Houthi targets in Yemen.

forecasts.question: Will the DSCA notify Congress by 31.12.2026 of arms sales to Taiwan with a combined value of at least 1 bn USD?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the sum of DSCA notifications for TECRO published after 23.09.2026 is at least 1 bn USD.

forecasts.question: Will Fitch or S&P downgrade Poland's long-term foreign-currency rating by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 Fitch or S&P downgrades Poland's long-term foreign-currency rating below A−.

forecasts.question: Will the EU Council adopt by 30.06.2027 a legal act allowing the frozen assets of the Bank of Russia themselves (not only windfall profits) to be used for Ukraine?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the EU Council adopts a regulation or decision (published in EUR-Lex) allowing the frozen assets of the Bank of Russia or their equivalent to be used for Ukraine, including through a loan secured by those assets. Political conclusions of the European Council do not count.

forecasts.question: Will Armenia and Azerbaijan sign a peace treaty by 30.06.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the leaders or foreign ministers of both states sign the text of a peace treaty (initialling does not count), as confirmed by both governments.

forecasts.question: Will ISW assess by 30.06.2027 that Russian forces have taken control of the whole of Kramatorsk or the whole of Sloviansk?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 an ISW report states Russian control over the whole of Kramatorsk or the whole of Sloviansk.

forecasts.question: Will the settlement price of the ICE Brent front-month contract on 20.10.2026 exceed 100.00 USD/bbl?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the settlement price of the nearest-expiry ICE Brent futures contract (on 20.10.2026 the December 2026 contract) on 20.10.2026 is above 100.00 USD/bbl. If the ICE settlement report is not accessible: the settlement reported by Bloomberg or Reuters wire (e.g. via Rigzone), then the Investing.com close. If there is no settlement that day, the last earlier settlement counts.
forecasts.resolution_source: ICE Futures Europe (Brent settlement); Bloomberg/Reuters wire; Investing.com

forecasts.question: Will the Statistics Poland (GUS) flash estimate of CPI inflation for October 2026 be below 3.5% y/y?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the first publication of the GUS flash estimate of CPI for October 2026 (expected about 30.10.2026) shows less than 3.5% y/y. NO if 3.5% or more. Later revisions and the final index do not count. If the flash is published after 31.10, the first flash publication still decides.

forecasts.question: Will the FAO Food Price Index (FFPI) for October 2026 be higher than 136.0 points?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the first publication of the FFPI for October 2026 (expected 06.11.2026) is above 136.0 points (the September value as first published on 02.10.2026). Revisions of September do not change the threshold.

forecasts.question: Will the governments of the USA and the PRC both announce by 10.01.2027 an extension of the trade truce beyond 10.01.2027 or a new trade agreement replacing it?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 08.10.2026 and 10.01.2027 both governments officially announce that the suspension of the measures of the Kuala Lumpur (Busan) arrangement is extended to a date after 10.01.2027, or announce a new trade agreement replacing it. US: White House, USTR, Treasury, Commerce or a Federal Register notice; PRC: MOFCOM, State Council Tariff Commission or MFA. Leaders' on-record statements count; statements of one side only do not.

forecasts.question: Will IMF PortWatch record at least 10 transits through the Strait of Hormuz on any single day between 08.10 and 17.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the daily total (n_total) for the Strait of Hormuz in the IMF PortWatch daily chokepoint series is 10 or more for any date from 08.10 to 17.10.2026, read once data to 17.10 are published (first publication). If data are not published by the next edition, resolution waits.

forecasts.question: Will IMF PortWatch record fewer than 20 transits through Bab el-Mandeb on any single day between 08.10 and 17.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the daily total (n_total) for Bab el-Mandeb in the IMF PortWatch daily chokepoint series is below 20 for any date from 08.10 to 17.10.2026, read once data to 17.10 are published (first publication).

forecasts.question: Will Saudi authorities report at least one person killed on Saudi territory by a missile or drone attack from Yemen between 08.10 and 21.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an official Saudi source (SPA, GACA, the coalition spokesman, a ministry or Civil Defence), directly or as cited by Reuters, AP, AFP or Al Jazeera, confirms at least one death on Saudi territory caused by a missile or drone attack launched from Yemen on a date from 08.10 to 21.10.2026. Houthi claims do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: spa.gov.sa; GACA; Reuters/AP/Al Jazeera citing them

forecasts.question: Will representatives of the US and Iranian governments meet in person in the same venue (directly or with a mediator in the same room) between 08.10 and 21.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the US government or the Iranian government confirms, and at least one independent outlet reports, an in-person meeting of their representatives in the same room on a date from 08.10 to 21.10.2026. Separate meetings of a mediator with each side (shuttle diplomacy), messages and calls do not count.

forecasts.question: Will a trilateral meeting of government delegations of the USA, Ukraine and Russia (at any level, including technical) take place between 08.10 and 31.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if at least two of the three governments confirm that delegations of all three governments met together in person on a date from 08.10 to 31.10.2026. Bilateral meetings, calls and meetings of mediators with one side do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the EU Council formally adopt by 21.10.2026 restrictive measures listing at least 1,500 new persons and entities under its Russia sanctions regimes?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 08.10 and 21.10.2026 the Council adopts one or more legal acts (Council press release or Official Journal) that together add at least 1,500 new persons and entities to the lists of the EU's Russia-related sanctions regimes. Agreement in Coreper alone does not count.

forecasts.question: Will the settlement price of the ICE Endex Dutch TTF front-month contract on 20.10.2026 exceed 80.00 EUR/MWh?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the settlement price of the front-month Dutch TTF futures contract on ICE Endex on 20.10.2026 is above 80.00 EUR/MWh. If the ICE Endex report is not accessible: Investing.com close, then Trading Economics. If there is no settlement that day, the last earlier settlement counts.

forecasts.question: Will the national average price of diesel in the e-petrol weekly quotation of 21.10.2026 be below 7.70 PLN/l?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the national average diesel (ON) price in the e-petrol.pl weekly quotation dated 21.10.2026 is below 7.70 PLN/l. If no quotation is published that day, the nearest earlier weekly quotation counts.

forecasts.question: Will the NBP average EUR/PLN rate of 21.10.2026 be higher than 4.4000?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if NBP table A of 21.10.2026 gives an average EUR/PLN rate above 4.4000. If no table is published that day, the nearest earlier table counts.

forecasts.question: Will Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense report at least 30 PLA aircraft around Taiwan in a single daily report published between 08.10 and 21.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if any MND daily report of PLA activity published from 08.10 to 21.10.2026 gives 30 or more PLA aircraft (sorties) detected around Taiwan.

forecasts.question: Will the Bank of Russia raise its key rate at the board meeting scheduled for 23.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the Bank of Russia press release on the decision of 23.10.2026 sets the key rate above 14.00%. If the meeting is postponed beyond 24.10.2026, NO.

forecasts.question: Will MOFCOM publish between 08.10 and 21.10.2026 an announcement extending beyond 10.11.2026, or repealing, the suspension of the rare-earth export controls of 09.10.2025?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if MOFCOM (alone or with the General Administration of Customs) publishes between 08.10 and 21.10.2026 an announcement that extends to a date after 10.11.2026, or repeals, the suspension of announcements Nos. 55-58, 61 and 62 of 2025. Readouts of talks that do not amend the legal text do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the US President increase the duty on goods of Russian origin under Section 112 of H.R. 5334 by an act published between 08.10 and 21.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if a proclamation, executive order or Federal Register notice published from 08.10 to 21.10.2026 raises the duty on all or part of the goods of Russian origin with reference to the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 (H.R. 5334). Announcements without a legal act do not count.

forecasts.question: Will OFAC add at least one new entry to the SDN list under a Russia-related programme between 08.10 and 21.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an OFAC Recent Actions notice dated 08.10-21.10.2026 adds at least one person, entity or vessel to the SDN list with the program tag RUSSIA-EO14024 or under authorities of H.R. 5334. Designations under other programmes (e.g. TCO, CYBER, IRAN) do not count, even if Russia-linked.

forecasts.question: Will UKMTO or JMIC report a merchant ship struck by a projectile, drone or mine in the Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb or the Gulf of Aden between 08.10 and 21.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if a UKMTO or JMIC notice (directly or as quoted by maritime press) reports that a merchant vessel was hit (physical impact on the ship, not only explosions nearby) in the Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb or the Gulf of Aden on a date from 08.10 to 21.10.2026.
forecasts.resolution_source: ukmto.org; JMIC; maritime press quoting them

forecasts.question: Will Iliana Iotova win more than 50% of valid votes in the first round of Bulgaria's presidential election on 25.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the Central Election Commission (CIK) result of the first round gives the Iotova-Valchev ticket more than 50% of valid votes. If the first round is postponed beyond 31.10.2026, NO.

forecasts.question: Will Likud win the largest number of seats in the Knesset election of 27.10.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the official results of the Central Elections Committee give the list headed by Likud (including a joint list in which Likud runs) strictly more seats than any other list. A tie for first place = NO. If the election is postponed beyond the deadline, NO.

forecasts.question: Will the Republican Party hold at least 50 seats in the US Senate after the 03.11.2026 elections?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if official results (certified, or called by AP where certification is pending) give Republicans at least 50 of the 100 seats in the Senate that convenes in January 2027, counting senators not up for election. Independents are not counted as Republicans. If a runoff is still pending on 31.12.2026, resolution waits for it.

forecasts.question: Will Abbas Araghchi cease to be Iran's foreign minister by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 08.10 and 31.12.2026 Araghchi is dismissed, impeached by the Majlis, resigns (resignation accepted) or a successor is appointed, as announced by the presidency, the Majlis or IRNA. An acting replacement during an absence does not count.

forecasts.question: Will the Polish Operational Command (DO RSZ) or the Ministry of National Defence confirm a violation of Polish airspace by an aircraft, helicopter, drone or missile from Russia or Belarus between 08.10 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if DO RSZ or the Polish MoD officially confirms that an aircraft, helicopter, drone or missile coming from the territory or airspace of Russia or Belarus violated Polish airspace on a date from 08.10 to 31.12.2026. Balloons carrying contraband do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the authorities of Romania, Bulgaria or Turkey confirm that a merchant ship was hit by a drone, missile or naval drone in their territorial sea or EEZ between 08.10 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the government, navy, naval authority or defence ministry of Romania, Bulgaria or Turkey officially states that a merchant vessel was hit by a drone, missile or unmanned surface vessel within that state's territorial sea or EEZ on a date from 08.10 to 31.12.2026. Attribution to a specific state is not required. Fires or explosions without a stated drone or missile cause do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: gov.ro; mapn.ro; Romanian Naval Authority; gov.bg; msb.gov.tr

forecasts.question: Will a USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker show at least three US aircraft carriers simultaneously in the CENTCOM area waters by 30.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if any weekly USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker published from 08.10 to 30.11.2026 places at least three US aircraft carriers at the same time in the Red Sea, Gulf of Aden, Arabian Sea, Gulf of Oman or Persian Gulf.

forecasts.question: Will Vladimir Putin personally attend the APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen (18-19.11.2026)?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if Putin is physically present in Shenzhen at the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting on 18 or 19.11.2026 (kremlin.ru or the host's official record). Video participation = NO. If the meeting is moved, the leaders' meeting held by 30.11.2026 counts; if it is held only online, NO.

forecasts.question: Will the EU formally open negotiating cluster 2 or cluster 3 with Ukraine at an intergovernmental conference by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the Council or the EU-Ukraine intergovernmental conference announces between 08.10 and 31.12.2026 the formal opening of cluster 2 (internal market) or cluster 3 (competitiveness and inclusive growth) of Ukraine's accession negotiations.

forecasts.question: Will BIS publish by 09.11.2026 a Federal Register document extending beyond 09.11.2026, or rescinding, the Affiliates (50%) rule whose suspension expires on 09.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if a BIS document published in the Federal Register from 08.10 to 09.11.2026 extends the suspension of the Affiliates rule to a date after 09.11.2026 or rescinds the rule.

forecasts.question: Will the Cameco month-end U3O8 spot price exceed 95.00 USD/lb for October, November or December 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the month-end spot price published by Cameco (UxC/TradeTech average) for the end of October, November or December 2026 is above 95.00 USD/lb.

forecasts.question: Will the EU Council adopt by 30.11.2026 a Russia sanctions act containing at least one new import or export prohibition?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 08.10 and 30.11.2026 the Council adopts a decision or regulation under the Russia sanctions regime that introduces at least one new prohibition on imports from or exports to Russia (including adding goods to existing prohibition lists). Listings of persons, entities or vessels alone do not count.

forecasts.question: Will S&P lower Poland's long-term foreign-currency rating or change its outlook to negative in a decision dated by 06.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an S&P Global Ratings decision dated between 08.10 and 06.11.2026 lowers Poland's long-term foreign-currency rating below A- or changes the outlook from stable to negative. PAP Biznes may be used if spglobal.com is not accessible.

forecasts.question: Will the US government impose a ban or mandatory quota on exports of diesel or other distillates by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an executive order, proclamation or Federal Register rule restricting exports of distillate fuels (ban, licence requirement or quota) is in force on any day from 08.10 to 31.12.2026. Voluntary industry commitments do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the European Commission send Poland a letter of formal notice concerning the reduced VAT rate on motor fuels by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if a Commission infringement decision (letter of formal notice or later stage) adopted between 08.10 and 31.12.2026 names Poland in relation to the reduced VAT rate on motor fuels under the VAT Directive (Commission infringement package or database).

forecasts.question: Will both the USA and the PRC put into effect reduced tariffs on goods from the Board of Trade 30-for-30 lists by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if by 31.12.2026 a US act (Federal Register or HTS notice) and a PRC act (State Council Tariff Commission or MOFCOM announcement) each make reduced tariff rates effective for goods from the lists published on 27-28.09.2026, with an effective date on or before 31.12.2026.

forecasts.question: Will a National Defense Authorization Act for FY2027 containing a numerical floor on US forces in the EUCOM area be enacted by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the FY2027 NDAA is signed into law between 08.10 and 31.12.2026 and its enacted text contains a provision restricting a reduction of US forces in the EUCOM area of responsibility below a stated number of personnel (in any form, including a certification requirement).

forecasts.question: Will Russia and Ukraine both confirm by 30.06.2027 a signed agreement on a ceasefire covering the whole front line?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 08.10.2026 and 30.06.2027 both the Russian and the Ukrainian government officially confirm the signing or entry into force of a ceasefire (truce, armistice or peace agreement) covering the entire line of contact. Sectoral ceasefires (energy, Black Sea, grain) do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the US-Denmark-Greenland defence agreement of 22.09.2026 enter into force by 30.06.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if by 30.06.2027 the government of Denmark, Greenland or the USA officially announces that the agreement has entered into force (e.g. the diplomatic note confirming completion of parliamentary procedures).

forecasts.question: Will the Federal Reserve suspend, restrict or attach new conditions to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority's access to the FIMA repo facility by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the Federal Reserve Board or the Federal Reserve Bank of New York publishes between 08.10.2026 and 31.03.2027 a decision suspending, restricting or attaching new conditions to the HKMA's access to the FIMA repo facility. A reply letter without a change does not count.

forecasts.question: Will ISW assess by 31.03.2027 that Russian forces have taken control of the whole of Kostiantynivka (Donetsk oblast)?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an ISW Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment published between 08.10.2026 and 31.03.2027 assesses that Russian forces control the whole of Kostiantynivka (or that the town has been captured). Russian MoD claims alone do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the US or Polish government officially announce by 31.03.2027 the location of a new permanent US Army base in Poland?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 08.10.2026 and 31.03.2027 the White House, the Pentagon, the Polish government or the President of Poland officially names the town or site of a new permanent US Army base in Poland. Lists of candidate locations do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the settlement price of the ICE Brent front-month contract fall below 70.00 USD/bbl on any trading day between 08.10.2026 and 30.06.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the ICE Brent front-month settlement is below 70.00 USD/bbl on any trading day from 08.10.2026 to 30.06.2027 (sources as in Q-0074).
forecasts.resolution_source: ICE Futures Europe; Bloomberg/Reuters wire; Investing.com
